quotes.text:
- type: product-details
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/releasenotes?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=esr
  conditions:
      release-types: [esr128, esr140, esr153]
- type: show-url
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/whatsnew?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=esr&oldversion=%OLD_VERSION%
  conditions:
      blob-types: [wnp]
      release-types: [esr128, esr140, esr153]
      products: [thunderbird]
      update-channel: esr

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A product-details condition uses release-types, while a show-url rule can also constrain update-channel. In 2024, the ESR release type was esr128 rather than esr. Current source lists esr128, esr140 and esr153 while the corresponding show-url update channel is still esr. Use the condition field that owns the decision and preserve the current release family. The linked bug includes beta follow-up history, so the first manual report alone was not proof for every channel. No update-service request was tested by this study.
title: Match release-note rules to release types and update channels separately
